summary: Autohome Inc. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US Form 8-K current report) on October 14, 2026, announcing that its board of directors will meet on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, Hong Kong time, to approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and to consider declaration and payment of a cash dividend, if any. Results will be published on the HKEXnews and company websites after Hong Kong trading hours and before the US market opens, followed by an 8:00 p.m. Hong Kong time earnings call. No special-situation terms are stated; watch for dividend declaration and Q3 performance.
